arguments.question: What is the current status of the failed job backlog on the primary?

arguments.recommended_next_step: Query the primary service to get the current failed job counts, and continue the investigation into why jobs are failing.
arguments.summary: Investigated the failed job backlog in the jobs database and found it has been growing all week. Exported the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. Booked the retro for Friday, but changed it to Thursday due to the all-hands meeting. Assigned Sam as the owner of the dashboards. Provided the notes in the shared drive in the 2024 folder. The failed job backlog on the primary is currently 1204 with 47 malformed rows.
